stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model on Hugging Face.
It pertains to the core area of text-generation using transformer models.
The model is associated with Meta's Llama family, indicating continued focus on large language models (LLMs).

stories.title: The first self-driving vehicle on Mars has proven to be a smashing success
stories.author: Eric Berger
bullet_points: Perseverance rover has demonstrated significant autonomous driving capabilities on Mars.
Approximately 90% of the distance covered by the rover was driven autonomously.
This marks a major success in the field of extraterrestrial autonomous navigation.

stories.title: DeepMind’s hurricane breakthrough has surprised weather scientists
stories.author: Victoria Turk, wired.com
bullet_points: DeepMind has achieved a significant breakthrough in weather prediction using AI.
The open-source WeatherNext model demonstrates accuracy even with lower-resolution weather data.
This development is surprising and has caught the attention of professional weather scientists.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights a trending model, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1, on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
The model is categorized for text generation and conversational AI tasks.
It utilizes standard ML components like transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the Meta-Llama-3-8B model, a significant large language model.
It is featured on Hugging Face Benchmarks, indicating its community relevance and performance tracking.
The associated pipeline is text-generation, placing it within the core NLP/Generative AI domain.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has secured $88 million in funding from prominent investors including Y Combinator and Benchmark.
The company is rapidly growing, currently serving 8.9 million developers.
The funding validates the growing market and adoption of open-source large language models (LLMs).

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 performance is significantly boosted in Ollama 0.31 on Apple Silicon.
The speed improvement is achieved through Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Performance gains reach up to 90% faster when utilized with coding agents, as validated by the Aider benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon using the MLX engine.
The performance improvements result in faster response times and higher quality model outputs.
The updated engine also demonstrates reduced memory consumption when running models.

stories.title: Ollama is now powered by MLX on Apple Silicon in preview
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a popular local LLM runner, is integrating MLX for performance gains.
The integration specifically targets Apple Silicon hardware, optimizing local AI inference.
This is currently available in a preview build, indicating ongoing development and optimization.

stories.title: OpenClaw
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenClaw is a personal AI assistant designed for local execution.
It integrates messaging apps with local AI coding agents.
The core feature emphasizes running all AI processes entirely on the user's own device for privacy/control.

stories.title: Judge rules Meta caused "public nuisance" and must fund mental health treatment
stories.author: Jon Brodkin
bullet_points: A New Mexico judge ruled that Meta caused a 'public nuisance' related to its platforms.
The ruling mandates that Meta establish a $567 million fund to address youth mental health issues.
This case represents a significant legal action holding a major tech company accountable for societal impacts.

stories.title: On-Policy Self-Distillation without Any Supervision
stories.author: Nuno Vasconcelos
bullet_points: Introduces a method for On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPD/OSPD) for LLMs.
Addresses the limitation of existing methods relying on external supervision (ground-truth, feedback).
Achieves true 'self'-distillation using only the model's own generations via internal consistency.

stories.title: Beyond Top-K: Replacing Black-Box Retrieval with Interpretable Agentic Operations
stories.author: Tabarakul Hazarika
bullet_points: Challenges the standard 'chunk-embed-top-k' paradigm in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for long documents.
Argues the standard approach is structurally unsound for complex, data-heavy documents like financial reports.
Proposes replacing black-box retrieval with more interpretable, agentic operations for improved accuracy.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 release brings performance improvements and enhanced GGUF model compatibility.
Integration leverages llama.cpp to broaden model support across various hardware setups.
The update augments Ollama's MLX engine, particularly benefiting Apple silicon users.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Introduction of NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra.
The model is specifically engineered for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
It is designed to support complex, long-running agent workflows.

stories.title: OpenJarvis: a local-first personal AI is now available to run with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenJarvis v1.0 is released as an open-source framework for building personal AI agents.
The framework emphasizes a 'local-first' approach, allowing AI to run entirely on the user's own hardware.
It features built-in support for Ollama, integrating local LLM execution.

stories.title: Subagents and web search in Claude Code
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has integrated support for advanced AI features within Claude Code.
The new capabilities include the implementation of 'subagents' for more complex task decomposition.
Web search functionality has been added to Claude Code via Ollama integration, enhancing information retrieval.

stories.title: X replaces its revenue-sharing program with ‘Original Content Rewards’
stories.author: Terrence O’Brien
bullet_points: X is replacing its existing revenue-sharing program for content creators.
The new initiative is called 'Original Content Rewards' and launches on September 8th.
Eligibility requires creators to have a minimum of 500 verified followers and 500,000 Home Timeline impressions.

stories.title: An Amazon data center could have the worst polluting power plant in the country
stories.author: Terrence O’Brien
bullet_points: Amazon is investing in a new power plant in West Texas to support its data center expansion.
The planned gas-burning power plant could become one of the largest single sources of greenhouse gas emissions in the US.
The news highlights the environmental impact associated with large-scale tech infrastructure development.

stories.title: Europe's free satellite service just made it easier to track wildfires
stories.author: Jeremy Hsu
bullet_points: The Copernicus Browser has been updated to include wildfire visualization capabilities.
This enhancement aids in tracking wildfires, particularly during a record wildfire season.
The feature leverages Europe's free satellite service for environmental monitoring.

stories.title: Learning When to Trust via Selective Context Preference Optimization
stories.author: Lingdong Kong
bullet_points: Addresses the vulnerability of language models to misleading external context signals.
Proposes 'selective trust' as a solution, moving beyond simple context resistance.
Introduces MIST, a new human-annotated benchmark for evaluating context trust in reasoning.

stories.title: Tracing the Heart: An Evidence-Linked Pipeline for Heart-Failure Feature Engineering
stories.author: Priyadarshini Kachroo
bullet_points: The paper addresses the significant bottleneck of EHR feature engineering in clinical AI, which consumes 39-45% of data scientists' time.
It focuses specifically on heart failure, a condition requiring complex integration of fragmented EHR data with clinical guidelines.
The proposed pipeline aims to improve upon existing rule-based and LLM methods by offering better automation and evidence traceability.

stories.title: AV-AIVAT: 74x Cheaper Agent Evaluation with Certified Anytime-Valid Stopping in Imperfect-Information Games
stories.author: Longbo Huang
bullet_points: Introduces AV-AIVAT, a method for evaluating AI agents in imperfect-information games.
Addresses the inefficiency of traditional agent evaluation by providing a certified anytime-valid stopping criterion.
Claims to reduce evaluation costs by up to 74x compared to existing methods while maintaining statistical guarantees.

stories.title: The Low Frequency Trap: Video Language Models Fail at Simple Event Bookkeeping
stories.author: Furong Huang
bullet_points: Video Language Models (VLMs) struggle with precise event bookkeeping in real-world video data.
Existing benchmarks are criticized for conflating event count, rate, duration, and visual complexity.
The paper introduces 'trace-grounded parametric profiling' to provide granular, executable ground truth for event counting.

stories.title: Challenges in Evaluating Explanation Methods for Static and Evolving Data
stories.author: Jerzy Stefanowski
bullet_points: The paper addresses critical limitations in evaluating Explainable AI (XAI) methods.
It demonstrates issues using the DetoxAI system for bias detection and concept unlearning.
Research explores adapting explanations, such as counterfactuals, to handle concept drift in evolving data streams.

stories.title: TRAJDEBUG: Tracing Error Lifecycle to Identify Critical Failures in Long-Horizon Agent Trajectories
stories.author: Juanzi Li
bullet_points: Introduces TRAJDEBUG, a method designed to trace the error lifecycle in long-horizon agent trajectories.
Addresses a key challenge in LLM-based agentic systems: identifying the earliest root cause of cascading failures.
Highlights the difficulty in debugging long trajectories where evidence for a single error can be scattered across many steps.

stories.title: Tytan: Interactive Neurosymbolic Construction of Analytic Semantic Schemas from Relational Data
stories.author: Kristian J. Hammond
bullet_points: Introduces TYTAN, a system designed to automatically construct analytic semantic schemas from raw relational data.
Addresses the 'knowledge-acquisition bottleneck' where semantic layers are currently manually created, limiting scalability and user accessibility.
Aims to improve data analysis tools by providing automated descriptions of entities, measures, and table relationships for natural language querying.

stories.title: Learning When to Trust via Selective Context Preference Optimization
stories.author: Lingdong Kong
bullet_points: Addresses the vulnerability of language models to misleading external context signals.
Proposes 'selective trust' as a solution, moving beyond simple context resistance.
Introduces MIST, a new human-annotated benchmark for evaluating context-aware reasoning.

stories.title: Tracing the Heart: An Evidence-Linked Pipeline for Heart-Failure Feature Engineering
stories.author: Priyadarshini Kachroo
bullet_points: Addresses the significant bottleneck of EHR feature engineering in clinical AI, specifically for heart failure.
Proposes an 'Evidence-Linked Pipeline' to automate the integration of fragmented EHR data with clinical guidelines.
Critiques existing methods (rule-based and LLM-based) for lacking full automation and maintainability.

stories.title: AV-AIVAT: 74x Cheaper Agent Evaluation with Certified Anytime-Valid Stopping in Imperfect-Information Games
stories.author: Longbo Huang
bullet_points: Introduces AV-AIVAT, a new method for evaluating AI agents in imperfect-information games.
Addresses the inefficiency of traditional agent evaluation by allowing stopping as soon as sufficient evidence is gathered.
Provides a formal guarantee that the evaluation's confidence level remains valid even with early stopping.

stories.title: CalibForge: Adversarial Solver Calibration for Scaling Learnable Terminal Tasks
stories.author: Kai Jia
bullet_points: Introduces CalibForge, an autonomous system for synthesizing terminal tasks in AI learning.
The system uses adversarial solver calibration to ensure tasks are appropriately challenging for learning agents.
Addresses the gap between task feasibility (solvability) and task relevance (behavior relative to a solver).

stories.title: RRC: Unlocking Generative Reward Models in LLM Reinforcement Learning via Ranking-Based Reward Construction
stories.author: Jingbo Zhu
bullet_points: The paper addresses a gap in LLM Reinforcement Learning (RL) by focusing on Generative Reward Models.
The core problem identified is the mismatch between the comparative nature of generative reward models and the scalar scoring required by RL algorithms.
The authors propose a method (RRC) to bridge this gap, aiming to unlock the full potential of generative reward models in RL.

stories.title: HarnessOpt-Bench: Evaluating LLMs at Harness Optimization
stories.author: Yuan Xue
bullet_points: The performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) in agentic systems is heavily dependent on the surrounding 'harness' (prompts, tools, control flow, etc.), not just the model weights.
The paper introduces HarnessOpt-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating automated harness optimization—the use of AI to iteratively improve the surrounding system components.
A key gap identified in the research is the lack of a common protocol within the community for measuring and standardizing harness optimization.

stories.title: Learning When to Trust via Selective Context Preference Optimization
stories.author: Lingdong Kong
bullet_points: Addresses the vulnerability of language models to misleading external context signals.
Proposes 'selective trust' as a solution, allowing models to appropriately weigh context.
Introduces MIST, a new human-annotated benchmark designed to test context-dependent reasoning.

stories.title: The Bitter Lesson of Tool Calling
stories.author: Vamse Kumar Subbiah
bullet_points: The paper investigates programmatic tool calling (PTC) as an advanced method for LLMs to act beyond training data.
PTC is presented as an evolution from rigid JSON tool calls, allowing for natural scripting, chaining, and parallelization in code-capable models.
The research addresses a gap by empirically comparing PTC against native JSON tool calling on established benchmarks under real-world conditions.

stories.title: AV-AIVAT: 74x Cheaper Agent Evaluation with Certified Anytime-Valid Stopping in Imperfect-Information Games
stories.author: Longbo Huang
bullet_points: Introduces AV-AIVAT, a method for evaluating AI agents in imperfect-information games.
Addresses the high cost and uncertainty of traditional agent evaluation methods.
Provides a certified anytime-valid stopping mechanism to ensure evaluation accuracy while minimizing resource usage.

stories.title: RP-OPSD: Reasoning-Pivot-Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation for Multilingual Reasoning Transfer
stories.author: Shujian Huang
bullet_points: The research addresses the challenge of multilingual reasoning transfer in Large Language Models (LLMs), particularly for low-resource languages.
It introduces RP-OPSD, a novel method that enhances On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) by explicitly guiding the distillation process with reasoning signals.
The core contribution is characterizing that effective target-language reasoning involves generating both surface-level and deeper structural information.

stories.title: Benchmarking the Benchmarks: Evaluating Benchmarks for Conversational Agents
stories.author: Abigail Goldsteen
bullet_points: The paper addresses the critical issue of poor quality in existing benchmarks used to evaluate conversational agents.
It introduces a novel, reference-free framework utilizing LLM judges to assess benchmark consistency, complexity, and policy coverage.
The framework offers actionable diagnostics to pinpoint weaknesses in current evaluation datasets, improving the reliability of agent testing.

stories.title: Benchmarking and Enhancing LLMs for Rule-Intensive Review of National Standard Documents
stories.author: Tianyong Hao
bullet_points: The paper addresses the gap in evaluating LLMs for complex, rule-intensive document review tasks.
National standard documents (e.g., China GB/T) are proposed as a challenging and representative testbed for LLM evaluation.
Current LLM benchmarks are criticized for focusing too much on domain knowledge and Q&A, neglecting structural and normative consistency checks.

stories.title: RRC: Unlocking Generative Reward Models in LLM Reinforcement Learning via Ranking-Based Reward Construction
stories.author: Jingbo Zhu
bullet_points: The paper addresses a limitation in applying generative reward models (GRMs) to Reinforcement Learning (RL).
The core issue identified is the mismatch between GRMs' comparative nature and RL algorithms' scalar scoring requirement.
The authors propose a method (RRC) to bridge this gap, unlocking the potential of GRMs in RL.

stories.title: HarnessOpt-Bench: Evaluating LLMs at Harness Optimization
stories.author: Yuan Xue
bullet_points: The performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) in agentic systems is heavily dependent on the surrounding 'harness' (prompts, tools, orchestration, etc.), not just the model weights.
Automated harness optimization—using AI to iteratively improve the surrounding system—is identified as a crucial, yet challenging, area for AI advancement.
The research highlights a current lack of a standardized protocol within the community for measuring and evaluating these complex LLM harnesses.

stories.title: 🏦 Vaya: an AI loan advisor that asks whether you can still afford to live
stories.author: minhlong2605
bullet_points: Vaya is an AI loan advisor designed to move beyond simple rate comparison.
Its core innovation is focusing on the user's affordability rather than just the lowest interest rate.
The tool aims to provide more holistic financial advice regarding loan suitability.
